title: Yearly 9 percent sewer rate increases
summary: On April 21, 2026, the committee approved a motion moving $500,000 from the sewer fund to reduce bond borrowing for a wastewater pump station project. A member had asked why savings keep carrying over while rates rise 9% every year. The department proposes another 9% average increase, about $2.2 million more, and a division chief said rates may stay near 9% for a couple more years before slowly easing.
